outcomeMeasures.populationDescription:
24 participants were treated.
10 patients experienced 16 SAEs.
Of these, 14 events were determined to be unrelated to treatment.
21 patients experienced treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs) with the most common being: rash (16 patients); nausea (10 patients); fatigue (7 patients); IRR, platelets decreased & vomiting (5 patients); lipase increased (4 patients); diarrhea, dry skin, and headache (3 patients each); and allergic conjunctivitis, anorexia, and AST increased (2 patients each).

outcomeMeasures.populationDescription:
A total of 25 patients have been enrolled (16 with HNSCC, 6 with TNBC and 3 with sqNSCLC); of the three cohorts only HNSCC fully recruited the first stage.
1 CR was observed in the HNSCC cohort.
The criteria for expansion of this cohort were not met.
No RECIST responses were observed in the other two cohorts.
AVID100 was well tolerated overall.
